variants.title: One cell driving the bulb
variants.unknown: the current one cell can drive
variants.note: The nominal emf of a zinc-carbon cell is 1.5 V. The internal resistance is this cell's own and is not a published constant.

source.title: IEC 60086-1, Primary batteries: nominal voltage of a zinc-carbon (R6) cell, 1.5 V

variants.title: Three cells in series
variants.sample: Three R6 zinc-carbon dry cells in series
variants.unknown: how the current grows with the number of cells
variants.note: Three 1.5 V cells in series give 4.5 V, and their internal resistances add as well, so the current grows but not quite three times.

source.title: IEC 60086-1, Primary batteries: nominal voltage of a zinc-carbon (R6) cell, 1.5 V
